name: shell-plugins-composable-multi-credential-2805
instr:
The shell-plugins SDK cannot provision several ordered credential usages as one deterministic, ownership-aware operation. Implement this without changing single-credential behavior, and return identical local and RPC results.

`ComposeProvisioners` must evaluate `ProvisionStep` values in order, attribute each accepted `ProvisionContribution` to its `ID`, and initialize empty collections when no steps exist. Compose environment names, normalized absolute file destinations, and cache keys atomically. Equivalent claims coalesce owners. Differences in values, file contents or secrecy, cache put data or expiration produce deterministic `CompositionConflict` values.

`ArgumentContribution` must preserve the executable, caller argument order, and usage order without reinterpreting arguments. Conflicting replacements publish no partial command. Cache removals precede compatible puts.

Diagnostics, panics, missing callbacks, unknown `ProvisionerID` values, and conflicts return `CompositionError` with its `Result`. Retain diagnostics and conflicts but publish no outputs. Unknown remote IDs stop dispatch.

Preserve AWS CLI, AWS STS, GitHub, ngrok, Redis, CrateDB, PyPI, Vercel, npm, and pnpm branching, configuration, overrides, normalization, delegation, and single-call `Provision` behavior while exposing separately owned contributions. `EnvVars` contributes only supplied fields. Generic file provisioning jointly owns its rendered file, path export, and arguments.
